title: Unique Grassy Korean Chicken Muchim
description: A light and refreshing Korean dish featuring sweet peppadew peppers, perfect for a sick day, with a grassy twist and high protein content. This bake-style muchim is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Spread the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, toss the sliced peppadew peppers with sesame oil and spread on a separate baking sheet.
Bake the peppers for 10 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
In a large bowl, combine the baked chicken, peppers, and chopped green onions.
Toss everything together to combine and serve hot.
Garnish with additional green onions if desired.
